info.title: Programmable Custom Launch API V3 general hook profile
info.summary: General project-owned Uniswap v4 hook graph request contract.
info.description: This document freezes revision 2 of programmable.direct-native-hook-graph.v1. It accepts project-owned tokens, project-owned hooks, all valid Uniswap v4 permission masks and three to sixteen exact direct graph targets. Every target is rebuilt from exact Standard JSON and materialized runtime bytes. A platform-issued receipt must bind the final graph and prove the declared 10 bps Programmable fee before the permit authority signs; the exact Router transaction is then simulated before it is returned for separate wallet review. Funding may be absent or use a separate EIP-3009 wallet signature. No API key can sign or broadcast a wallet transaction.

post.summary: Submit an exact V3 general-hook request
post.description: Submit the byte-identical CLI-derived request. Every target remains per-launch bound to exact source, build, creation/runtime bytes, final calldata and simulation evidence. The permit signer is blocked until the exact final graph has a valid platform conformance receipt.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Exact-request idempotency binding. It must not contain an API key or wallet signature.

200.description: An exact Idempotency-Key replay returns the existing V3 resource.

202.description: A new request is durably accepted for exact validation and conformance processing.

503.description: A transient dependency is unavailable. Honor Retry-After and retry only the byte-identical request; never fall back to another create version.

error.message: A required production dependency is temporarily unavailable

get.description: Version-matched newest-first wallet-owned list. Pending rows may receive bounded best-effort reconciliation; use single-resource GET for precise polling.

The single-resource contract is the precise polling source for conformance state, any exact funding challenge and, after validation and simulation, the exact Router transaction. The API never signs or broadcasts either wallet action.

404.description: Launch not found for this wallet principal.

post.summary: Submit one explicitly wallet-signed EIP-3009 authorization
post.description: Website-BFF to backend handoff only; this is not an API-key CLI operation. The website must first authenticate the wallet principal, show and validate the exact challenge, request eth_signTypedData_v4 only after an explicit user action, verify the canonical signature client-side, and then submit it once with a durable Idempotency-Key. Acceptance does not send the separate Router transaction.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Durably binds this exact signature body. An identical replay returns 200; body substitution under the same key returns 409.

parameters.name: X-Programmable-Privy-User-Id
parameters.description: Server-verified Privy principal. Browsers must not manufacture this header directly.

parameters.name: X-Programmable-Wallet-Address
parameters.description: Checksum wallet address already proven linked to the authenticated principal by the website BFF.

200.description: Exact Idempotency-Key and body replay; returns the existing full V3 resource without applying the signature twice.

202.description: First acceptance of the exact canonical signature. The resource advances to funding_authorization_verified, simulating, or authorized; the Router transaction still requires a later explicit wallet send.

400.description: Malformed schema, signature, digest, launch binding, or Idempotency-Key.

403.description: The verified principal does not control the launch wallet.

404.description: Launch not found for this wallet principal.

409.description: Idempotency substitution, stale funding intent/digest, or a launch that already advanced under different authorization bytes.

CustomLaunchApiKey.description: Wallet-bound API key loaded from PROGRAMMABLE_API_KEY or the supported operating-system secret store. It is never accepted as an argument or prompt and grants no wallet signing authority.

CustomLaunchWebsiteToken.description: Server-to-server credential held only by the Programmable website BFF. A browser authenticates its own wallet session to the BFF and never receives this token.

V3IntegrationPending.description: A required V3 production dependency is temporarily unavailable.

error.message: A required production dependency is temporarily unavailable

NonzeroCanonicalUint256.description: Nonzero base-10 uint256 with no sign or leading zeroes.

SelectedFeeHundredthsOfBipV1.description: Intent-bound selected total from 0 through 999999 hundredths of a bip. The effective total is max(selected,1000).

initializerTargetId.description: Must reference a direct graph target whose componentKind is other. Initializer is a role, not a component kind.

platformFeeBindingTargetId.description: May reference the hook or another exact direct graph target that implements the declared platform fee binding.

DirectNativeTargetRolesV1.description: The token, hook and initializer IDs are distinct. The platform fee binding target may be a separate project-owned component.

PlatformFeePolicyV1.description: The exact assessment pair and accounting mode are intent-bound. The server recomputes all derived fee values.

DirectNativeHookPermissionPolicyV1.description: All fourteen Uniswap v4 permission bits are supported. Return-delta permissions require their corresponding action permission and the hook address low bits must match the declaration.

oneOf.description: Native ETH value is carried only by the exact Router transaction returned after conformance and simulation for separate wallet review.

productionLaunchAuthorized.description: The V3 general profile is production authorized; runtime trust roots and conformance receipts still fail closed independently.

DirectNativeHookGraphProfileV1.description: General direct-graph profile. The current embedded value remains false until the exact-graph fee-conformance authority and production readback are promoted; request bytes cannot activate it.

fee.description: Static fee 0..999999 or the Uniswap v4 dynamic-fee sentinel 0x800000.

DirectNativePoolKeyV1.description: Currencies are distinct and sorted by numeric address. The hook address low bits must equal the declared 14-bit permission mask.

targetId.description: Must equal targetRoles.platformFeeBindingTargetId and name an exact graph target.

DirectNativePlatformFeeBindingV1.description: The server recomputes project and effective values for both directions and rejects any mismatch.

FundingSignaturePatchDescriptorV1.description: Derived unsigned initializer binding. Offsets include the four-byte selector, are distinct, satisfy (offset-4)%32=0, remain in bounds and identify all-zero ABI words. The create request still contains no signature bytes.

Eip3009FundingAuthorizationDescriptorV1.description: Unsigned descriptor only. It requires validAfter < now < validBefore. It contains no signature, v, r or s. Its nonce is derived from the pre-signature funding intent, not from signature-bearing initializer calldata.

CustomGraphBundleV3.description: The Router primitive supports 2 through 16 targets, while this V3 profile requires 3 through 16 because the project-owned token, project-owned hook and initializer roles are distinct. The hook may use any valid Uniswap v4 permission mask; return-delta permissions require their corresponding action permission.

DirectNativePermitWindowV1.description: Exact Router permit validity window. deadline must be after validAfter and no more than 3600 seconds later.

fundingIntentHash.description: Pre-signature domain-separated funding intent. It is not a sha256: label and does not include signature-bearing initializer calldata or a final graph commitment.

CustomLaunchCreateRequestV3.description: Closed unsigned V3 create envelope for a project-owned token, project-owned hook and complete 3-16 target launch graph. The request contains no wallet signature or transaction approval, and additional properties are rejected.

Eip3009FundingTypedDataV1.description: Exact eth_signTypedData_v4 payload. The connected wallet, chain, domain, to, value, nonce and validity window must be checked client-side before the explicit signature action.

path.description: Single-resource website wallet-admin handoff returned by the backend. It is not an API-key CLI operation.

signature.description: Canonical 65-byte lower-case r || s || v serialization. The website submits it only after an explicit wallet signature action.

FundingAuthorizationSubmissionV1.description: Website wallet-admin handoff schema. It is exposed only on the website-token operation and never on an API-key CLI operation.

ExactWalletTransactionV3.description: Exact Router transaction for a second, separate wallet review and explicit send. It is never auto-signed or auto-broadcast.

FundingBoundaryV3.description: Closed wallet-authority boundary repeated on every V3 output stage. Funding is EIP-3009 without an approval transaction or Permit2; the service neither produces the wallet signature nor broadcasts the Router transaction.
